Name: Cat to Vulpix for Alternative Textures
Author: srnluvly
Description:
[left][b][u][color=#ff0000]PLEASE NOTE I DID NOT MAKE THE ASSETS,
I MERELY TURNED IT INTO AN AT PACK.[/color]


[/u][/b]Do you love your cats but also love the adorable vulpix from Pokemon? Well with this mod, you can now turn them into the vulpix duo using alternative textures! Simply buy the scissors from Robin after downloading the Alternative Textures mod and click on your cat, then search the name 'Vulpix' or 'AlolanVulpix' or scroll down until you find your wished skin!

Have fun!
